v1.14.0 SHIPPED 2026-05-05 (tag 290ffe0). All five theme E issues closed: #99 (project-resolution refusal, PR #104), #102 (MCP audit absolute path, PRs #106/#107), #100 + #101 (size-budget shed + write-amp guard, PR #108), #103 (tier semantics docs, PR #109). Release was clean — workflow first try, no #98 retry needed, Homebrew tap auto-updated.

REBRAND DECIDED 2026-05-06: codexCLI → Reverie. Next major release is Reverie v1.0.0, not codexCLI v1.15.0 or v2.0.0. See project.releasePlan for full phased plan, project.identity for thesis, project.commercialContext for GTM context.

V1.15.0 IS NOT HAPPENING under that name — the soak-cycle planning was superseded by the rebrand decision. Items previously slated for v1.15 are now either:
- IN Reverie v1.0.0 scope (Bun migration, short-flag audit)
- DEFERRED to Reverie v1.1+ (web app/visualization, search improvements, entry health #84, cross-machine telemetry)

Test count at v1.14: 1394 (will likely shift under Bun migration if vitest is replaced).

DOGFOODING PART THREE: still expected, now naturally pairs with Reverie launch as the rebrand-narrative blog post.

NEXT SESSION LIKELY PICKS UP: see context.next_session for handoff state. User wrapped 2026-05-06 with "a lot to think about" — needs reflection time before committing to execution.
